name: enfurl-monorepo
description: enfurl: roll a link up into a furl that is the link, unfurl it anywhere. Stateless URL compression, nothing stored.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/codec -w packages/cli -w apps/web -w apps/edge --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/codec && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/edge/tsconfig.json --noEmit

author: Burak Bayraktaroglu
